records.claim: Birth defects can happen in any pregnancy for different reasons. Out of all babies born each year, about 3 out of 100 (3%) will have a birth defect. We look at research studies to try to understand if an exposure, like mirtazapine, might increase the chance of birth defects in a pregnancy. Studies and case reports have looked at nearly 5,000 pregnancies with mirtazapine exposure and have not found an increased chance of birth defects.
records.source_section: Does taking mirtazapine increase the chance of birth defects?
